services.name: Snorkel the Reef
services.desc: Immerse yourself into a liquid crystal underwater world 3 Hours About Florida is home to the third largest natural barrier reef in the world. Our snorkeling trips offer guests a unique opportunity to immerse themselves into a liquid crystal underwater world. Our crew will take you to the undersea John Pennekamp State Park, one of the most abundant marine life locations on the reef. Be fascinated by many of the 1400 species of vibrant corals, plants & tropical fish on a "guided" exploration through this incredibly beautiful ecosystem. services.name: Christ of the Abyss
services.desc: This iconic statue is one of the most famous sites visited by snorkelers 3 Hours About Donated to Key Largo in 1965, this is a memorial for all who have lost their lives at sea. This iconic statue is one of the most famous sites, visited by snorkelers and divers from around the world. It is located in a beautiful section of the reef in John Pennekamp State Park and is surrounded by many soft corals and a wide array of fish. The statue depicts Christ's offering of peace. services.name: Private Sunset Cruise Key Largo
services.desc: Tranquility in the Keys 2 Hours About The Florida Keys are world renowned for their captivating sunsets! Set out on this evening cruise from the southern side of the island admiring the immensity and sheer beauty of the Atlantic Ocean. Enjoy a scenic passage through the natural mangrove sanctuaries watching for native birds, manatees, and dolphins. Then we'll head out to sparkling waters where you will witness the sun gently slip into the ocean. A tranquil experience to end your perfect day in Key Largo. Included Large cooler with ice & bottled water Complimentary photo package Not 2 Hours • PRIVATE Tour • Up to 6 people • Tranquility in the Keys
